Stéphanie L.reason: Verified non-Canadian artist. Stéphanie L is the Paris-based French singer-songwriter whose 2015 album Quadraphare is released under the Stéphanie L. artist name. French concert and artist profiles state that she lives and works in Paris, and Apple Music ties the same stage name directly to Quadraphare, so this entry should not remain in Northern Dial's Canadian artist catalogue.
